The Step-1 dependency-input artifact remains its historical snapshot and predates the added direct exponential-convexity supplier; current item frontmatter, owned manifest, and proof contracts agree. The full transitive proofs behind every published supplier were not independently re-audited; only the exact interfaces and proof sections needed for these claims were checked. At handoff, autopilot had not yet counted batch 4's reader artifact, so no engine-level collection is claimed; status also showed an unrelated split-8 blocker outside this assignment.
